Bibliographic record attributes A History of Women Tobacco Workers: Labor, Community and Social Transformation in Lebanon, 1895-1997 to Malek Hassan Abisaab, with University of New York at Binghamton and the year 2001.
Rashed Chowdhury’s McGill History PhD thesis Pan-Islamism and Modernisation During the Reign of Sultan Abdülhamid II, 1876-1909 names Malek Abisaab as supervisor in the acknowledgements (p. 7).

notes: The linked AHA record matches the independently documented institution, year and dissertation title. The catalogue uses the fuller name Malek Hassan Abisaab. Chowdhury’s thesis title page is dated 2011; the supplied AHA student entry lists 2012.
